Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry?
Are you interested in helping international brands/organisations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!
TransPerfect’s vision is to be the world's premier provider of global language and business solutions. We will accomplish this by applying our values, passion, dedication, and innovation to help our clients improve their businesses and achieve their goals on a global scale.

Our services portfolio covers everything from business support services such as interpretation, multicultural and digital marketing, SEO and website globalisation to multimedia work, video, e-learning and training, and legal support services.

All services and client partnerships are aided by best-in-breed software platforms, specialised in optimising business processes.

s.h: That’s enough about us – what about you?
s.t:
We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore, the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.
If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you! We have over 140 offices worldwide, but this particular opportunity is to be based in one of our offices in Paris, London or Milan.

The main focus of this role is sales and business development focused on the Life Sciences industry and requires a person with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive attitude in outbound sales.

Develop prospective clients through several strategies including internet sourcing, trade show lists, referrals, various professional directories and personal investigation
Foster and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (trade shows, regional organisations, etc.)
Responsible for growing new business from existing clients, including working closely with senior leadership to expand current relationships and up-sell the TransPerfect portfolio
Creatively problem solve to improve current new business development strategy
Negotiate rates and deadlines with prospective and current clients
Educate prospective and existing clients regarding the translation process, including TransPerfect’s rates, justification for turnaround time, and competitors’ information
Liaise with production to ensure that all jobs are handled appropriately and with keen attention to detail, resulting in a perfect product
Consistently follow up with clients to ensure their satisfaction with delivery, quality and customer service
Understand all industries that TransPerfect markets to including industry leaders, current events and any other pertinent data

Commit to a high level of integrity and service
Superior written and spoken communication skills in French & English
Deliver quality work
Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

s.h: Owning your performance and taking responsibility
s.t:
Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment
Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect
Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures
Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers
Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives
Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions
Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Problem solving mindset
Strong interpersonal skills with prior experience in a client facing role
Strong written and spoken communication skills
Good analytical skills with attention to detail
Most importantly, the ideal candidate must demonstrate ability to: multitask in a fast-paced environment, work well with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures, build strategic relationships with clients and co-workers, work as part of a team, take active measures to solve problems and commit to a high level of service

Ready for a challenge?
Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience.
Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe.

Just Eat is expanding its delivery services, offering customers not only food from their favourite restaurants but also everyday groceries from local supermarkets and convenience stores.
With rapid growth in grocery delivery, this is a key opportunity for Just Eat to disrupt the market and win customers, partners and loyalty to put us ahead of our competitors.
This position is responsible for managing and performing key account management activities for selected Grocery & Retail Key Accounts in order to achieve set commercial targets and contribute to optimal customer satisfaction.
We're looking for someone who can live our behaviours of lead, deliver and care, bring fresh ideas, challenge the status quo, and push for bold, creative solutions to drive the Just Eat vision forward.

s.h: These are some of the key components to the position
s.t:
Managing and building relationships with a portfolio of key accounts in grocery & retail segment (e.g. big supermarket chains), to ensure the continuation of business and customer satisfaction
Onboarding & Trainings of new and existing stores including Troubleshooting
Developing and implementing account plans for the own key account(s) including expansion potential, Marketing activities and increasing of customer experience.
Leading or participating in the negotiations with key accounts and preparing proposals for contracts for potential partners.
Preparing, explaining and following-up on management reports (i.e. on sales performance), in line with requirements
Advising key accounts on how they can optimally make use of JETs solutions and offerings including Discounts, Deals, Stamp Cards, etc.
Local and Global Best Practice Transfer and Training allows you to maximize your performance.
Together with your colleagues in Grocery & Retail Team you are developing this segment in Just Eat Switzerland.

s.h: What will you bring to the team?
s.t:
Proven track record managing strategic/enterprise accounts in retail or gastronomy or a service oriented industry.
Native German speaker, Professional fluency in English, other language skills like Italian and French would be highly appreciated.
Result oriented: Track record of exceeding targets and delivering results
Client-focused: Prioritizing the needs and advocacy of our partners to ensure satisfaction.
Agile mindset: Displaying high flexibility while thriving within rapidly evolving business landscapes.
Entrepreneurial spirit: Self-motivated individual driven by initiative and a proactive mindset.
Technical skills: Digital/Tech savvy with G-Suite, Salesforce or other CRM Tools, Reporting Tools, AI-Tools (Gemini, Claude, etc.)
People by from people they trust: this position requires a person with very high communication, social and networking skills and a high level of reliability and responsibility.
At JET, this is how we play
Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment.
Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side.
At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again.
Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition.

No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com . s.h: Are you ready to join the team? Apply now!
s.t: Originally posted on Himalayas

· Develop and execute a Mass Market sales plan for an assigned territory or portfolio, with accountability for pipeline development, bookings, revenue growth, and achievement of sales targets.
· Identify, prospect, qualify, and develop expansion opportunities with government agencies, municipalities, public sector organizations, and other target clients.
· Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients by serving as a trusted advisor and primary commercial point of contact throughout the sales process.
· Lead consultative sales conversations to understand client objectives, operational challenges, business requirements, and desired outcomes, and position solutions that address those needs.
· Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and discovery through solution development, proposal, negotiation, contracting, and close.
· Develop account strategies, opportunity plans, presentations, proposals, and business cases that clearly communicate the value and expected outcomes of Verra Mobility solutions.
· Conduct executive-level presentations, demonstrations, meetings, and negotiations with decision-makers and stakeholders across client organizations.
· Build and maintain a healthy, accurate sales pipeline and provide regular forecasts, opportunity updates, competitive intelligence, and risk assessments to sales leadership.
· Collaborate cross-functionally with Client Success, Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, Marketing, IT, and other internal teams to develop solutions, respond to client requirements, and successfully close business.
· Coordinate responses to RFPs, RFIs, solicitations, and other formal procurement processes, ensuring submissions are accurate, compelling, compliant, and aligned with client requirements.
· Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, contracts, and agreements in partnership with leadership and internal stakeholders while protecting company objectives and creating long-term customer value.
· Develop territory and account plans that identify target organizations, key stakeholders, buying processes, competitive considerations, and opportunities for expansion.
· Maintain a strong understanding of Verra Mobility products, services, market positioning, industry trends, competitive offerings, and client use cases in order to effectively articulate differentiated value.
· Monitor market and competitive activity and communicate trends, customer feedback, and emerging opportunities to sales and company leadership.
· Partner with Client Success and other teams to ensure a smooth transition from closed sale to implementation and ongoing client relationship management.
· Maintain accurate and timely customer, opportunity, activity, and forecast information within CRM and other required systems.
· Represent Verra Mobility at client meetings, industry events, conferences, and other business development activities, with travel as needed for prospecting, sales presentations, negotiations, and relationship management.

· Bachelor's degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience is required.
· 5+ years of progressive experience in B2B sales, enterprise sales, account management, business development, or a related client-facing commercial role.
· Demonstrated track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets and developing new business within complex sales environments.
· Experience selling to government agencies, municipalities, public sector clients, or regulated industries strongly preferred.
· Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, procurement processes, contracts, and executive decision-makers.
· Demonstrated ability to prospect, develop relationships, qualify opportunities, build pipeline, and convert opportunities into revenue.
· Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills, with the ability to understand customer challenges and connect business needs to differentiated solutions.
· Proven ability to build trusted relationships with executive leaders and decision-makers and effectively communicate business value at multiple organizational levels.
· Strong business acumen and analytical skills, with the ability to develop account strategies, assess opportunities, understand financial considerations, and make data-informed decisions.
· Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, with the ability to deliver compelling proposals, presentations, demonstrations, and executive-level business cases.
· Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities, deadlines, stakeholders, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
· Experience working collaboratively across Sales, Client Success, Operations, Product, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams.
· Strong technical aptitude with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook); experience with CRM platforms preferred.
· Self-motivated, competitive, and action-oriented, with the resilience and persistence required to develop business and navigate complex sales cycles.
· Willingness and ability to travel as needed for client meetings, onsite presentations, implementations, industry conferences, and business development activities.
Verra Mobility Values
An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:
Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
Do What’s Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.
With your explicit consent which you provided as part of the application process, we will retain candidate personal data solely for the business purpose for which it was collected. **Sie verbinden Leadership, Verkaufsstärke und Begeisterung für Innovation? Dann bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit, bei Neho ein erfolgreiches Vertriebsteam zu führen und gemeinsam den Schweizer Immobilienmarkt neu zu definieren.**
Neho ist eines der marktführenden Maklerunternehmen der Schweiz. Wir stehen für innovative Immobiliendienstleistungen, die menschliche Expertise mit leistungsstarken digitalen Lösungen vereinen. So ermöglichen wir einen schnelleren, transparenten und qualitativ erstklassigen Immobilienverkauf. Eine Besonderheit: Wir bieten unseren Service zu einem Festpreis statt für eine Provision, weil wir das für fair und zeitgemäss halten.
**Als Verkaufsleiter:in tragen Sie die Gesamtverantwortung für unser Sales Team in der Deutschschweiz. Sie führen direkt 4 regionale Sales Manager sowie 2 Outbound Sales Spezialisten und rapportieren direkt an unseren Chief Sales Officer.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Neho Geschäftsleitung sind Sie einer der Hauptakteure bei der Revolutionierung des schweizerischen Immobilienmarktes.

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die es schafft, mit fundiertem Fachwissen, Empathie und transparenter Kommunikation ein Team zu motivieren und zu inspirieren, um ausgezeichnete Verkaufserfolge zu erzielen.**
**Ihre Aufgaben**
* In dieser verantwortungsvollen Position führen Sie 4 regionale Sales Manager direkt \- und damit indirekt ein Team von rund 25 Immobilienmakler:innen in der gesamten Deutschschweiz. Ausserdem sind Sie verantwortlich für 2 Spezialisten im Outbound Sales vor Ort in Zürich
* Mit Verkaufstrainings, Coachings und regelmässigen Feedback\-Gesprächen unterstützen Sie Ihre Sales Manager in der Führung ihrer Teams und sind die erste Anlaufstelle für immobilienspezifische Fragen auf Führungsebene
* Sie betreiben Analyse und Beratung für das Team zur Erarbeitung und Anpassung individueller und regionaler Verkaufsstrategien und kontrollieren die operative Planung und Umsetzung der Ertrags\- und Kostenziele
* Sie führen, entwickeln und coachen das Outbound Sales Team in Zürich setzen so die Grundlage für eine erfolgreiche Kundenakquise
* Sie analysieren und optimieren unsere internen Vertriebsprozesse und sind der erste Ansprechpartner für das Product Team für die stetige Optimierung der Neho Plattform sowie des CRM Systems
* In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Teamleiter des Innendienstes stellen Sie eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit zwischen Innendienst und Sales sicher und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Makler im Tagesgeschäft optimal unterstützt werden
* Im Rahmen unseres starken Wachstums sind Sie zusammen mit der HR Abteilung verantwortlich für die Rekrutierung, das Onboarding neuer und der Entwicklung bestehender Mitarbeitenden
* Überwachung, Auswertung und Reporting von Zielvorgaben und KPIs sowie definieren von Zielen auf individueller und regionaler Ebene
**Was wir Ihnen bieten**
* Ein etabliertes, schnell wachsendes Scale\-Up mit knapp 150 Mitarbeitenden
* Unterstützung im Tagesgeschäft sowie auf strategischer Ebene in diversen Bereichen, Marketing für Branding und Leadgenerierung, Product \& IT in der Entwicklung von Tools und Produkten sowie HR in der Rekrutierung und Mitarbeiterentwicklung
* Hohe Eigenverantwortung in Ihrer Arbeit mit Flexibilität in der Zeit\- und Arbeitseinteilung
* Moderne IT\-Ausrüstung und benutzerfreundliche digitale Plattformen sowie Zugang zu diversen Ressourcen im Bereich AI (Lizenzen, interne Experten, externe Coachings)
* Die Chance, direkt und konkret an der Entwicklung des Unternehmens mitzuarbeiten und den Immobilienmarkt in der Schweiz neu zu definieren
* Start\-up\-Feeling, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine inspirierende Arbeitsatmosphäre
* Moderne Büros im Circle mit Blick auf den Flughafen Zürich
* 5 Wochen Ferien \+ zusätzliche Tage nach Betriebszugehörigkeit, Möglichkeiten für Remote\-Arbeit im Ausland, vollständig bezahlter Mutterschafts\-/Vaterschaftsurlaub, regelmässige Teamevents und vieles mehr!
**Ihr Profil**
* Nachgewiesene Erfolge beim Aufbau und/oder der Leitung eines Vertriebsteams, vorzugsweise mit Führung über mehrere Ebenen
